methodologyNotes: 12 notable home security cameras selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, covering the full spectrum a buyer evaluates: wired indoor-only, battery-powered indoor/outdoor, solar-powered outdoor, ultra-budget wired, and premium AI-integrated. Seeds verified against manufacturer spec pages (ring.com, arlo.com, eufy.com, wyze.com, tp-link.com), official support/spec pages (support.blinkforhome.com, support.google.com/googlenest, support.wyze.com), and corroborated by reputable third-party reviews (PCWorld, AndroidPolice, HowToGeek, 9to5Google, Digital Camera World, PR Newswire announcements). Ring.com product pages returned HTTP 404 for all direct product paths throughout this session; specs sourced from Ring's own support article (ring.com/support/articles/731m0), PCWorld review, and AndroidPolice review. Google Store redirects to GDPR consent for non-EU visitors; Nest Cam specs sourced from support.google.com/googlenest official help and 9to5Google launch coverage. Arlo product pages return only site header HTML; Arlo Pro 5S 2K specs sourced from PCWorld review, Digital Camera World review, and Arlo's own PR Newswire announcement. priceUsd = US MSRP for the single-camera base configuration; where the camera ships only in bundles (Blink Outdoor 4 requires Sync Module), the per-camera reference price is noted. specKeys chosen for comparability: resolution (pixel dimensions as string), indoor_outdoor (boolean true=both, false=indoor-only or outdoor-only with clarification in provenance), power (string), field_of_view_deg (diagonal degrees as number), local_storage (boolean), cloud_subscription (string: 'required', 'optional', 'free-tier-included', 'none'), night_vision (string), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.

products.name: Ring Stick Up Cam Pro (Battery)
products.priceNote: MSRP $179.99 for battery or plug-in model per PCWorld review and 9to5toys launch coverage. Solar kit $209.99.

specs.power: Rechargeable battery; plug-in (USB-C) or solar panel options
specs.night_vision: Color and infrared (user-selectable); built-in radar for 3D motion Bird's Eye View

products.provenance: Specs sourced from ring.com/support (fetched 2026-06-15) and corroborated by AndroidPolice review (fetched 2026-06-15) and PCWorld review (fetched 2026-06-15). Ring product URLs returned HTTP 404 throughout session. Key confirmed specs: 1080p HDR, 155° diagonal (139° H, 80° V) FOV, radar-based 3D motion detection, Bird's Eye View, color night vision, dual-band Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz, built-in siren, wired/battery/solar power. No local storage — Ring Protect subscription required starting $3.99/month or $39.99/year. Local storage requires Ring Alarm Pro base station. Release: October 18, 2023 per 9to5toys launch article. MSRP $179.99.

products.name: Ring Spotlight Cam Plus (Battery)
products.priceNote: MSRP $149.99 for battery or plug-in model confirmed on safehome.org review citing Ring pricing; wired model $179.99.

specs.power: Rechargeable battery; plug-in, hardwired (100–240 V), or solar panel options
specs.night_vision: Color night vision; 2 motion-activated LED spotlights (375 lm each, up to 25 ft)

products.provenance: ring.com/support/articles/731m0 (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: product name 'Spotlight Cam Plus', 1080p HD, 140° horizontal / 80° vertical FOV, battery/plug-in/hardwired/solar power options, outdoor use, color night vision. No local storage; Ring Protect subscription required. MSRP $149.99 for battery/plug-in per safehome.org review. 2022 release confirmed by Amazon listing ('2022 release'). indoor_outdoor=false because product page specifies outdoor; can be used indoor but marketed as outdoor.

products.name: Google Nest Cam (Battery)
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP $179.99 confirmed by 9to5Google launch article (August 2021). Current street price may vary.

specs.power: Built-in rechargeable Li-ion battery (6 Ah); optional weatherproof USB-C cable
specs.night_vision: IR (6x 850 nm LEDs, up to 20 ft); no color night vision on this model

products.provenance: support.google.com/googlenest/answer/9259110 (official Google Nest specs page, fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 1080p at 30fps, 130° diagonal FOV, IP54 rated (indoor/outdoor), built-in 6 Ah rechargeable battery, 6× 850 nm IR LEDs up to 20 ft. local_storage=true: device stores up to 1 hour of clips locally when Wi-Fi is offline (per SlashGear / 9to5Google coverage, corroborated by SafeWise review). Free tier includes 3 hours of event history; Google Home Premium (formerly Nest Aware) $8/month for 30 days or $14/month for 60 days of history. Release August 24, 2021 per 9to5Google. MSRP $179.99 at launch.

products.name: Google Nest Cam (Indoor, Wired)
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP $99.99 confirmed by Google Nest blog ('starting at $99.99') and multiple retail listings.

specs.power: Wired — attached 10 ft USB-A cable with 7.5 W adapter
specs.night_vision: IR (2× 850 nm LEDs, up to 15 ft)

products.provenance: support.google.com/googlenest official specs page (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 1080p at 30fps, 135° diagonal FOV, 2× 850 nm IR LEDs up to 15 ft night vision, 10 ft USB-A power cable, indoor-only (no weather rating). local_storage=true: includes up to 3 hours of event video history on-device (no subscription needed for that baseline). Google Home Premium $8/month adds 30-day history. MSRP $99.99 at launch per Google Nest blog and Micro Center listing. Release September 2021 (exact date from Google blog 'available today' post).

products.name: Arlo Pro 5S 2K
products.priceNote: MSRP $249.99 per camera confirmed in Arlo PR Newswire announcement (November 2, 2022). Street price has been around $199.99 per PCWorld.

specs.power: Rechargeable battery (up to 8 months); optional solar panel or AC adapter
specs.night_vision: Color (via integrated spotlight) and black-and-white infrared

products.provenance: PR Newswire announcement (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 2K HDR, 160° FOV, weather-resistant, battery-powered, color night vision, announced November 2, 2022. PCWorld review (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 2560x1440 resolution, 160° diagonal FOV, 12× digital zoom, dual-band Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz, built-in siren, Arlo Secure subscription $4.99/month single camera or $12.99/month unlimited for cloud recording up to 60 days. local_storage=false: requires separate Arlo Hub ($100) for local recording. MSRP $249.99 per camera; Digital Camera World review corroborates specs.

products.name: Arlo Essential Indoor Camera (2nd Gen)
products.priceNote: 2K version MSRP $79.99 confirmed on amazon.com listing ('2nd Gen, 2023 Release'). 1080p version is $39.99.

specs.power: Wired (requires outlet; tabletop or wall mount)

products.provenance: Amazon listing confirms 2K 2nd Gen 2023 Release at $79.99. AndroidPolice review (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 2560x1440 (2K), 130° diagonal FOV, wired (AC power), indoor-only, automated privacy shutter, B&W IR night vision (single 850 nm LED), no local storage (no microSD slot, no hub support), Arlo Secure subscription $8/month for 30-day cloud history. 30-day paid cloud trial included at purchase. WebSearch confirms $39.99 for 1080p version, $79.99 for 2K version.

products.name: eufy SoloCam S340
products.priceNote: MSRP $199.99 confirmed on eufy.com/products/t81701w1 (single unit). Home Depot lists at $199.99.

specs.power: Built-in rechargeable battery (3 months standalone); removable 2.2 W solar panel included
specs.night_vision: Color night vision (f/1.6 aperture) and B&W infrared

products.provenance: eufy.com product page (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 3K wide-angle (2880×1620) + 2K telephoto (2304×1296) dual-lens, 135° FOV, solar-powered (2.2W included panel, 3-month battery standalone), outdoor IP67 rated, 8 GB built-in eMMC local storage (no subscription needed), 360° pan / 70° tilt, 8× hybrid zoom, AI detection (people/vehicles), color night vision, $199.99 MSRP. HowToGeek review corroborates all key specs. cloud_subscription='none' because no cloud plan is required; optional cloud storage available via eufy service.

products.name: eufy Indoor Cam E30

specs.night_vision: Dual: infrared (32.8 ft) and color with built-in spotlight (16.4 ft)

products.provenance: eufy.com product page (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 4K UHD resolution, 125° diagonal FOV, wired AC power, indoor-only, microSD local storage supported (card sold separately), no mandatory subscription ('all functions without subscription fees'), dual night vision (32.8 ft IR + 16.4 ft color with spotlight), 360° pan / 75° tilt, AI auto-tracking, HomeKit support, $69.99 MSRP. MacRumors news (December 16, 2024) corroborates launch date and specs. Release date December 2024 per MacRumors.

products.name: Wyze Cam v4
products.priceNote: MSRP $35.98 for single unit on wyze.com.

specs.power: Wired USB (6 ft micro-USB cable); outdoor power adapter sold separately
specs.night_vision: Dual: IR (4× 850 nm LEDs) and color (starlight sensor with Enhanced Color Night Vision)

products.provenance: wyze.com product page (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 2560×1440 (2.5K QHD), DFOV 115.8° (HFOV 98.5°, VFOV 53.1°) — rounded to 116° diagonal, IP65 weather-resistant (indoor/outdoor), wired USB power, microSD up to 256 GB for 24/7 local recording (no subscription for local storage), optional Cam Plus cloud subscription $2.99/month per camera, dual night vision (IR + starlight color). Release March 26, 2024 per Wyze forum official announcement. MSRP $35.98 single unit.

products.name: Wyze Cam OG
products.priceNote: MSRP $19.98 (sale from $29.98) on wyze.com. Frequently found at $19.99–$20 on Amazon.

specs.night_vision: Color (1080p Color Night Vision via 4× IR LEDs + dual 40-lumen spotlights)

Release January 17, 2023 per Wyze forum official announcement. MSRP $19.98 on wyze.com (was $29.98); field_of_view_deg=121 (121.4° per spec sheet, rounded).

products.name: Blink Outdoor 4
products.priceNote: Per-camera MSRP approximately $109.99 (standalone add-on camera). 1-camera starter kit with Sync Module 2 is $119.99. Prices have declined significantly since launch.

specs.power: 2× AA 1.5V lithium batteries (up to 2-year life); optional weather-resistant AC adapter

products.provenance: Blink official tech specs page (fetched 2026-06-15) confirms: 1080p HD, 143° diagonal FOV, 2× AA lithium batteries up to 2 years, outdoor (weather-resistant), IR night vision. local_storage=true: local storage via USB drive (Sync Module 2) or microSD (Sync Module XR) — Sync Module sold separately. cloud_subscription='optional': Basic ($4/month or $40/year) or Plus ($10/month or $100/year); 30-day free trial included. Release August 24, 2023 per TechDigest/AndroidPolice. AndroidPolice review confirms $110 standalone camera price. indoor_outdoor=false: marketed and rated as outdoor only.

products.name: TP-Link Tapo C120
